links.outcome: Readability (ARLC) and quality of chatbot patient information on female urinary incontinence
links.effect: Mean ARLC differed significantly across chatbots (p = 0.047); Grok was easiest to read and Mistral highly complex; authors conclude readability and quality need improvement.
links.quote: AI-supported chatbot technology needs to be improved in terms of readability and quality of patient information regarding female UI.

screen.reason: Evaluates the readability and quality of patient education responses generated by ten commercial LLM chatbots for female urinary incontinence using automated and rubric scoring without testing a deployment safeguard or practice.
